lines.speaker: trickyboi
lines.text: I'm not eating Splendamin!

lines.speaker: trickyboi
lines.text: I demand a hamburger! Or a hot dog!

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Look around you. There's no way we have those here.

lines.speaker: trickyboi
lines.text: That's not my problem! Just bring me one! What kind of Nikke talks back, anyway?

lines.speaker: trickyboi
lines.text: I thought the Central Government was coming. Where are they, huh?

lines.speaker: trickyboi
lines.text: How long are you going to keep us locked up in this disgusting dumpster of a place?!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What's his problem this time?

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Beats me. He just started acting like that a little while ago.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: Ever since he got here, really.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: He's such a pest.

lines.speaker: trickyboi
lines.text: Let's go, everyone!

lines.speaker: trickyboi
lines.text: I don't know what kind of game they're playing, locking us up in here, but I don't wanna find out! Who knows what could happen?

lines.speaker: trickyboi
lines.text: Hey, you over there!

lines.speaker: trickyboi
lines.text: Are you gonna tell us what's going on? I've heard you eat people!

lines.speaker: trickyboi
lines.text: What are you going to do with us? Huh?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: What is he talking about?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Should I go make him shut up?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Forget it. Just ignore him.

lines.speaker: trickyboi
lines.text: See that? They're ignoring me! They're not saying anything because they're hiding something!

lines.speaker: trickyboi
lines.text: Think about it, people! If something happens here, no one will know!
Murmuring begins to spread through the rest of the crowd.
One by one, they start speaking out.
"He's right! How much longer do we need to stay here?"
"I've got work piling up back home. Who's gonna take responsibility for all this lost time?"
"All these Nikkes, and they can't even do a proper job protecting us."
"I think I got injured during the evacuation. Are those Nikkes going to compensate us?"
"This whole mess happened because the Nikkes couldn't do their job."
Complaints start to pour out like a flood.
Anis feels disgust welling up within her again.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You're telling me these are the people I risked my life for...

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Anis. Can you help me with this?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: These blankets were in the partition's storage. They need a good shake.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Some of the people are cold since there's no light or anything in here.
Anis looks at the pile of blankets stacked beside Mint.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: ... Sure.
A loud thud sounds as Avistar accidentally drops something.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Oops.

lines.speaker: trickyboi
lines.text: Geez, watch it! I almost got hurt!

lines.speaker: trickyboi
lines.text: Ugh, I can't take this anymore! Is the Central Government even coming?
Tricky Boi's outburst sets off another round of shouting from the crowd,
full of profane curses and vulgar gestures.
Anis stares at the scene as she helps Mint shake out the blankets.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Mint.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Are you really able to sing and dance for those people?

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Anis...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: They're so self-absorbed, and they laugh when someone makes an effort.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: They enjoy watching others fail, and when someone succeeds, they tear them down.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: They treat altruism as a joke and scorn sacrifice.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: The Ark is full to the brim of people like that.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: And I'm supposed to sing and dance for them? Even risk my life?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Do you think they're worth that?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I don't.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Look closely, Anis.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: At what?

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Just look.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: At what?! I'm tired of looking at these people.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Why can't you see it? Is something wrong with your eyes?

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Look carefully, okay?
Mint grabs Anis by the head and forces her to turn.
Prika and Avistar are busily distributing supplies from the partition.
Someone hands Prika a bottle of water.
A middle-aged man washes the face of a girl with an injured hand.
The girl shows a wealthy-looking woman how to open a Splendamin bar.
A young man tears his clothes to wrap around someone's ankle.
A middle-aged woman pours water on someone's scraped knee.
A child helps disinfect the wound on someone's head.
An old man feeds food to someone who can't eat by themselves.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Do you see that?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: ... Yeah.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Not so bad? Right?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I guess I've only been focusing on the ugly stuff.
Anis makes eye contact with someone helping.
They smile and give her a small nod.
Anis awkwardly nods back.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Phew...

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: That should do the trick until the health officials arrive.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: There are over two hundred people here, but it went pretty smoothly thanks to everyone's help.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: Anis, here.
Prika tosses Anis a piece of candy.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: That kid said to give it to you as a thank you for carrying her on your back.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Oh... Right.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: Hmm? What's with her?

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Dunno.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You didn't put that little girl up to this or anything, did you?

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Those people saw how hard you were working and wanted to help.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: They're grateful for what you did.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Huh...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I, uh...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I don't think I've ever seen something like this happen in the Ark.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Anis.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Remember the people who called for help when you collapsed in the practice room, and kept massaging your arms and legs?

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: The ones who carried you all the way to the hospital, and then collapsed from exhaustion?

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: The nurses at the hospital who comforted you?

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: The people on the street who asked if you were okay afterwards?

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Those people have always been there.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Y-yeah, I guess you're right.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: They were always there...
Anis looks at the people again.
Tricky Boi and his gang are nowhere in sight. There is no sound of them either.
All she sees are people helping each other.
They're the ones at the forefront.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: ... They're the stars.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I never realized the Ark had them...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: But it turns out it's always been full of stars.
*Rumbleeeee*

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What's that?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: An earthquake? In the Ark?
Murmurs ripple through the crowd.
Groups of people huddle together and stare at their phones.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Hold on.
Avistar rushes over and peeks at one of the phones.
When she returns, her face looks pale.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: A-Anis.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Wh-what's wrong?

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Look at this.
Avistar lifts up a phone.
On the screen is a live stream.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: After the terrorist attack on the Ark, a lot civilians started flying drones on the surface that broadcast their feed.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: This is the most popular channel among them.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: How do civilians have access to the surface?

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: It's mostly done illegally, but the government sanctioned a few of them, saying it would help keep the public's mind at ease.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Sometimes Raptures appear on screen, but even that helps raise awareness, they said.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: So why are you shaking? What's wrong?

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: J-just wait.
*Rummmmble*

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Looks like there's something definitely going on...
The video continues.
A towering black spire with wings and horns is moving.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Is that a... Rapture? No, that's Dark Matter, so... Wh-What is this?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: And why is it so big? Those're buildings next to it, right?

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: This thing is, uh... It's...

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: It's heading straight for the Ark.
*Rummmmble*

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: At its current pace, they say it'll arrive within three hours.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Enikk.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What is that thing?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: That is classified.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: It must be a Heretic, and since it's covered in Dark Matter, it's somehow related to the Four Beasts.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: That is a likely possibility.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: A large wave carried it into our surveillance area.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: A large what...?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Wave. Further details are unknown.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Have any forces been deployed to intercept?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: That is classified.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Of course it is. Thanks.
The communication cuts off.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: It'll be fine. The Ark should be able to block it.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: It's nothing to worry about... right?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: P-plus, we have Dorothy.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Er... I didn't tell you this earlier because I didn't think it was very important,

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: but Eyeri contacted us, and apparently Dorothy is not currently in the Ark.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What about Absolute and Matis?

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Absolute has been deployed for a recon mission up north, and Matis has joined up with the Commando Unit.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: And... Aegis?

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: I heard they joined the Commando Unit as well, but that they're on their way back.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: So... we're in big trouble, yeah?

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: I believe so, yes.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Really...?

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: What's going to happen...?
*Rummmmble*

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: It's all right. I'm sure the Commander and Rapi will...
Anis suddenly gets an ominous feeling.
A strange sensation that she's experienced many times before.
She's being watched.
Anis quickly looks around.
Everyone is staring at her,
not saying a word.
Their eyes are filled with unease, but they haven't lost their glimmer.
They're filled with expectation.
Anis realizes the stars are watching her.
She takes a step forward.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Enikk, I'm going to the Ark.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Open the partition.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Are you heading to Tetra Line's headquarters?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: How did you know?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I know many things.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The front partition is unusable. I will guide you to the nearest one that connects to Tetra Line.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I'll be back, everyone!

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Where are you going?

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: If you ditch the performance, I'll never forgive you.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: I'll contact you right away if something happens.
Anis runs off.
Everyone by the partition keeps their eyes fixed on her as she leaves.
